manual_bridges.evidence: Dossier includes CIA archive proposals of tachyons and reverse information flow, technical objections and Ukrainian archival UAP reports. It explicitly reports no direct tachyon detection and no empirical Ukraine-UAP bridge.
manual_bridges.falsifier: An authenticated primary record with calibrated physical measurement and a carrier-specific independent observable; mere declassification is insufficient.

manual_bridges.evidence: EYE benchmark explicitly makes UAP bridge H5 unavailable and carrier-specific H4 mandatory. Apply competing ordinary, information and physical model families to UAP only after measurement gates.
manual_bridges.falsifier: A preregistered test that distinguishes an ordinary model from a carrier-specific alternative, with independent data.

manual_bridges.evidence: Tachyon Star transfers isolated A/B/C cadence idea to real sky surveys; Palomar and POSS-I concern candidate transients, detector and observing-schedule controls. T1: 0 isolated B events in 8 qualified, 1 unresolved; T2: 0 isolated B in 20 sensitivity-qualified, 8 unresolved.
manual_bridges.falsifier: Freeze independent coordinates and cadence before pixels opened; local injection sensitivity; detector/moving-object controls; independent instrument; repeat.

manual_bridges.evidence: Traveler separates target, execution, write, Git and observer time; Phoenix Lights separates report date, local event time, UTC, observer locality and inferred object position. One-second early recorded Git timestamp unreplicated; arrival-order inversion not physical reversal.
manual_bridges.falsifier: Independent calibrated clocks and synchronized bearings, uncertainties, known acquisition sequence; never infer propagation from database timestamps.

manual_bridges.evidence: Retro-SHA had no match and no physical channel; Deutsch v2 blind both models 131/256, one-sided p=.377365; 0/32 exact bytes, both Brier worse than uniform. UAP needs pre-event commitments, not retrospective selection; a verified FAA row is not prediction evidence.
manual_bridges.falsifier: Commit prediction before independently generated target, prevent shared inputs/leakage, preregister all attempts and null; independent replication.

manual_bridges.evidence: SIMPTOMAT 1296 synthetic vectors, 704/8640 neighbor label flips, 532 unstable vectors; distinct latent mechanisms may yield identical counts. DemiHead R5D public text corpora do not qualify as authenticated physical witness holdout. UAP eyewitness reports similarly do not identify unique causes without independent data.
manual_bridges.falsifier: Independent timestamped physical measurements; witness reports kept as reports; prospective held-out adjudication.

manual_bridges.evidence: Tachyon Star defines new windows without nuclear events and retains old schedule confound. UAP archive records no nuclear causation; Phoenix Lights 1997 lacks a recorded Nevada nuclear explosive test in that year. Do not treat nuclear events as carrier or trigger by default.
manual_bridges.falsifier: Exposure-matched denominator, calendar precommit, nonnuclear windows and held-out controls.

manual_bridges.evidence: Official FAA XLSX row 50 records orange-white UAS and preliminary damage unknown. This is an ordinary aviation-report comparator, not a tachyon candidate.
manual_bridges.falsifier: Only promote if independently calibrated measurements require a nonordinary model after alternatives tested.

next_gate.name: R1.1 CARRIER IDENTIFIABILITY
rules: Use independent observational and timestamp provenance; separate archival co-mention, explicit lineage, methodological analogy and empirical evidence.
Freeze source windows and primary metrics before looking at target outcomes.
Retain nulls, unresolved sensitivity failures, conventional explanations and source quality.
No physical carrier attribution without independent calibrated carrier-specific observable.

limits: Path and keyword matches are discovery, not relevance or proof. Direct-topic tag is heuristic, not manual scientific admission.
All structured keys and string leaves scanned; first 80 Tachyon and 20 UAP hit rows and 120 external link rows per document retained; total counts and omission counts explicit.
Malformed JSON screened for raw terms, not silently repaired.
External source links not retrieved in this run.
No arbitrary graph-neighbor expansion into the core; explicit refs retained separately.

counting_contract: Exact path overlap, reference and co-mention are distinct metrics; not independent experiments and not evidence of a shared physical carrier. Zero empirical physical links means none established by reviewed material, not universal proof of absence.
